text:
deploy-bot: Deploy blocked for production-canary — tag v2.3.1-rc4 (commit d4f7a1b). CI gate failed: integration-tests/payments-e2e. Logs: https://ci.redwood/internal/12345
Alex C: saw the alert. which test is failing?
Priya S: payments-e2e is timing out on the final settle step, looks like a timeout not a compile error. we saw a flake on staging earlier today.
Jamie L: hold canary promotion. do NOT roll forward to prod.
Marta G: agreed. given change window we should pin back to v2.3.0 for canary while we triage.
Alex C: can we try a quick CI retry on the same commit? if it's transient that might unblock.
Priya S: queued a retry: `ci retry 12345` — but if it fails again we need to rollback within the 30m change window.
Jamie L: @deploy-bot can you set a 20m auto-rollback timer to v2.3.0 if CI doesn't green?
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Auto-rollback scheduled: revert canary to tag `v2.3.0` if CI not green by +20m. Manual override: `@deploy-bot override hold`.
Marta G: adding brief note to release notes draft: "hotfix: canary withheld due to payments e2e failure; investigating flaky test; pinning canary to v2.3.0 until resolved."
Alex C: Priya, please triage logs and post a short summary here in 10m. Jamie, prepare rollback steps in case deploy-bot triggers.
Priya S: on it — grabbing logs and running locally. will share top 3 suspects in chat.
Jamie L: rollback doc ready: steps + verifications, DB migration safe path confirmed. I'll stand by.
ci-bot: CI retry finished — integration-tests still failing (payments-e2e). Failure snippet: `TimeoutError: settle-step exceeded 120s`
Priya S: looks consistently failing now, not just flakey. investigating external dependency calls to payment-gateway mock.
Alex C: ok, proceed with rollback plan if no fix in next 10m. keep escalation light — update status to #incidents if it widens.
Marta G: will update customer-facing release notes after rollback completes.
Jamie L: noted. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
